hook.visual: Face, then Claude logo over a terminal, then a pixel mascot swinging a hammer at a row of 'SEO agency' cards that grey out.

beats.what: Face says 'Claude' with a word caption
Split: Claude logo pops over a terminal above the face
Pixel mascot smashes 'SEO agency' cards with a hammer
Cut back to face: 'if your business relies on being found online'
Split screen: YouTube video and site of the Claude SEO tool on top
Zoom punch on the 'CLAUDE SEO' title
Features page: fix broken links, schema markup, content analysis
Full face: this will matter more over time
'First save this video', then the URL appears on screen

characters.who: Claude's orange pixel mascot holding a hammer
characters.enters: Appears centred on a dark full-frame card at 1.5 s, replacing the face
characters.acts: Swings the hammer and greys out a row of 'SEO agency' cards, acting out 'destroyed'
characters.exits: Fades as the cards vanish, hard cut back to the face at 2.8 s

why_it_works: The mascot acts out the claim (smashing agency cards) in the first 3 s, so the bold line is seen, not just heard
Proof follows the claim: real site pages and a feature list fill the top half while he talks
'Save this video' before giving the URL turns the CTA into saves (1,991 shares)
weaknesses: The tool pages are dark and their text is small; features are hard to read
Ends mid-sentence on the URL, so the payoff is an address, not a result
The mascot gag is used once and never returns
for_robert: Copy the 1-second mascot gag: Fred acts out the hook verb (smash, eat, swim past) in a full-frame pixel shot, then cut straight back to Robert, and bring Fred back once later.
